name: Happy Star Congratulations
look: A children's award certificate on a blue, star-speckled background. Big yellow letters say "Congratulations" above blank "Presented to" and "for" lines. A grinning yellow star with a red nose trails a streak reading "You did it!" in purple, with "Date" and "Signed" lines below.
use: A mock award handed out sarcastically for a tiny, obvious or questionable achievement. The "Presented to" line names the winner and the "for" line names the unimpressive accomplishment, like replying to an email.
slots: who gets the award (on the "Presented to" line)
examples: Drinking one glass of water today
Closing the fridge door for once
